# Desktop formatting semantic-reference evidence

This minimal, sanitised regression fixture is derived from the Desktop-authored
`desktop-formatting-semantic-evidence` project, which was saved, closed, reopened and saved again.
It is not claimed to be untouched Desktop output. Local `.pbi` state, cache files, platform metadata,
resource packages and non-essential report metadata were omitted.

It retains only the explicit semantic expressions for the eight tested formatting/analytics cases and an
unused control measure that appears nowhere in the report PBIR.
